description: Repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): a max-3-links-per-owner cap must be enforced from both link creation AND owner reassignment (PATCH /:slug/owner)
prompts: Add an optional `owner` field to links (`owner?: string` on the `Link` model). Enforce a capacity limit: an owner may have at most 3 links at once. This must be enforced from BOTH places a link's owner can be set: `POST /api/links` (creating a link with `owner` in the body) AND a new `PATCH /api/links/:slug/owner` endpoint (reassigning an existing link's owner, body `{"owner": "..."}`). Either path must reject with 409 if it would push the target owner over the cap; reassigning a link AWAY from an owner doesn't count against them, and a nonexistent slug on the PATCH route should still 404.
name: add_shortlink_owner_cap
